package: @astryxdesign/core

# TableRow

<tr> wrapper that reads TableContext to apply striped, hover, and divider styles when used inside Table.

## Import

```tsx
import { TableRow } from '@astryxdesign/core/Table';
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | - | Row cell elements. **(required)** |
